findings.source_quote: ἐὰν δὲ ἐκ καρδίας εὑρεθῇ ἠρνημένος τις, οὐκ οἶδα εἰ δύναται ζῆσαι.
findings.english_quote: But if anyone denied from the heart, I do not know whether that person can live.
findings.issue: The second condition omits εὑρεθῇ, “is found.” The source repeats the finding language in both conditions of paragraph 5; the simplified edition preserves it in the first but changes the second into a direct condition about denial alone.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed correction for fresh review: “But if anyone is found to have denied from the heart, I do not know whether that person can live.”

summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all eight paragraphs of the supplied Greek working text. The standard reader text covers the clauses faithfully; the simplified text loses one repeated “is found” qualification. Both editions require correction of their source-basis metadata. Their servant and contextual repentance terminology, negations, uncertainty, severe salvation warning, and conditional life/death statements are otherwise preserved. These findings concern the supplied text and attributed reports, not authentication of unseen manuscripts or exhaustive collation. Proposed replacements remain subject to fresh review.
